title: The Fenwick Road Card
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: The night bus driver hands you a card. Read it.
first_visual: A laminated card in a gloved hand through the cab window; the header hidden by the driver's thumb.

beats.visual: A gloved hand offers a laminated card through the cab window; thumb over the header.
beats.vo: The night bus driver hands you a card. Read it.

beats.visual: An old man across the aisle asks the time; Ivy: 'Not yet.' He nods, relieved.
beats.vo: Three: if anyone asks the time, say 'not yet'.

beats.visual: Depot ahead; Ivy stands; the driver tenses in the mirror.
beats.vo: Four: nobody rides past the depot.

beats.visual: Card close-up: the thumb lifts; header PASSENGER SAFETY: THE WOMAN FROM FENWICK ROAD.
Key moment: Ivy finally looks at the window; her reflection is Ash Violet with lamp eyes, no breath fog.
beats.vo: The rules weren't for me. They were about me.

beats.visual: The driver, softly: 'Not yet, love.' The bus turns at the depot loop.

ending: The driver, gently: 'Not yet, love.' The bus loops at the depot and the card is offered again.
loop_note: Yes. It ends as the bus loops and cuts back to frame 1 with the card being offered again. She rides every night.

originality_review: Original. A rules card that turns out to be a guide to surviving the narrator is our own inversion. It does not use the 'If your mom ever' template, and it is distinct from MW001's rule inversion (here the reader is the threat).
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: A night bus driver hands Ivy a card of after-midnight rules. She follows every one. When the driver lifts his thumb from the header, it reads 'PASSENGER SAFETY: THE WOMAN FROM FENWICK ROAD'. The rules are for surviving her.

hooks.line: The night bus driver hands you a card. Read it.
hooks.first_visual: A laminated card in a gloved hand through the cab window; the header hidden by the driver's thumb.

hooks.line: Rule three: if anyone asks the time, say 'not yet'.
hooks.first_visual: An old man across the aisle leaning to ask something.

hooks.line: Every passenger had the same card. Eyes down.
hooks.first_visual: A bus of people holding identical cards.

hooks.line: Then the driver moved his thumb.
hooks.first_visual: A thumb sliding off the top of a laminated card.

hooks.line: The rules weren't for me. They were about me.
hooks.first_visual: A reflection in a black bus window, wrong-coloured and breathless.

setting: Night bus No. 9, the route past Fenwick Road to the depot loop.
conflict: Ivy follows the rules, believing they protect her.
escalation: Left side only, avoid reflections, 'not yet', never past the depot.
reveal: The header names her. In the window her reflection is Ash Violet, lamp-eyed, and her breath leaves no fog.
